title: Fishing Contest
start: Talk to Vestri or Austri, near the White Wolf Mountain.

items.t: Garlic (available as a respawn on the table in a Seers' Village house, in an upstairs drawer of Morgan's house in Draynor Village, or in a player-owned house larder)

recommended.t: Ability to run past level 33 guard dogs
Active Seers' Village lodestone and either Catherby lodestone or Taverley lodestone

rewards.t: Access to the White Wolf Mountain shortcut
The ability to use the mine cart system to White Wolf Mountain (also requires completion of the quest The Giant Dwarf)

steps.t: Talk to either Austri (north of the Taverley lodestone) or Vestri (north of the Catherby lodestone) who can both be found guarding caves on either side of White Wolf Mountain. [Chat: 1 I was wondering what was down that tunnel? › 2 Why not? › 3 If you were my friend I wouldn't mind it. › 1 Well, let's be friends! › 1 And how am I meant to do that? › Accept]
If you don't have the worms:

sub.t: Go to McGrubor's Wood just west of the Seers' Village lodestone and enter through the loose railing along the north fence, or use fairy ring ALS .
Run to the west side of the woods and 'check' the red-coloured vines to receive red vine worms; take at least three.
Additionally, if you don't have garlic, you can find one in the house south of the Seer's Village anvil.

steps.t: Head to Hemenster (south-west of Seers' Village and directly west of the Ranging Guild).
Use the garlic on the eastern wall pipes by the north side.
Either talk to Bonzo and pay him 5 coins or fish at a fishing spot to start the contest. [Chat: 1]
Fish at the newly obtained fishing spot until a Raw giant carp is caught.
Report back to Austri or Vestri.
